title: Model Landscape Explorer: unified catalog + alerting playbook
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a repeatable, queryable 'Model Landscape Explorer' product + playbook that centralizes signals about public and partner models for Product, Sales, Research, and Runtime teams. This ticket covers the PM scope: signal definition, scoring rubric, user journeys, alert policies, stakeholder onboarding, and an MVP dashboard spec. The intent is to reduce time-to-insight for model substitution, procurement risk, and rollout decisions and to provide eventing (alerts + slack) for model availability or capability regressions.
success_metrics:
- Time to answer "What compatible model can replace X" reduced from 3 days to <2 hours
- Internal NPS for model sourcing workflows >= 70
- Alerts actionable rate >= 85% (alerts that lead to triage or plan within 48h)
- First 10 cross-team adopters (Sales/Runtime/Research) onboarded within 6 weeks
acceptance_criteria:
- Canonical signal schema defined and documented
- Ingestion pipelines for 4 public sources (Model Hubs, Vendor status pages, Price lists, Release notes) implemented end-to-end in prototype
- Scoring rubric implemented with weights editable in UI
- MVP dashboard with filtering by capability, latency tier, quantization support, license, and region availability
- Alerting rules (deprecation, major version bump, latency spike >20%, price >15%) configured and test alerts delivered to #model-watch slack channel
tasks:
1) Workshop: define signals + rubric (PM/R&D/Runtime/Legal) -- Week 1
2) Data ingestion prototype (ENG) -- Week 1–2
3) Schema + storage (ENG/Infra) -- Week 2
4) Dashboard MVP (Dev/Product) -- Week 3
5) Alert rules + routing (SRE/Product) -- Week 3
6) Internal alpha w/ 10 users + feedback loop -- Week 4
7) Iterate on weights and UIs then ship internal GA -- Week 5–6
data_sources: Hugging Face model hub (public metadata + tags)
Internal telemetry: latency/throughput from Redwood runtime
Customer field reports and sales intelligence
ingestion_cadence: daily for telemetry and price lists; weekly for public hubs and vendor statuses; immediate for release notes via webhook
ui_requirements:
- Searchable catalog with facets: architecture, seq_len, quantization, float type, params, license, region availability, SLA compatibility, latency band
- Time-series view per model for latency and token cost
- Side-by-side comparison view for up to 4 models
- Editable scoring weights and scenario presets (low-latency, low-cost, enterprise-compliance)
- Exportable recommendations and a one-click create-issue flow to propose rollouts
alert_triggers:
- Model deprecation announcement detected
- New major version with incompatible API or license change
- Observed latency regression >20% over 24h for any production route
- Quantization/compatibility flag missing for a model we rely on
- Price increase >15% or removal from partner catalog
rollout_plan: Alpha: internal PM/Runtime/Research (weeks 4–6) -> Beta: Sales + 5 customers (weeks 7–10) -> GA: org-wide with handbook and runbook (week 12). Post-GA: weekly steward meetings and monthly rubric calibration
